description: Buu's house: a white round house like a lying caterpillar, with a big head dome, four round segments trailing to the right, and a long round tube lying on top with its flat front to the front left.
layout: Middle: the lower body lies along x, z -1.1 to 1.1, straight on the ground with no stone base: a big white head dome (x -3.04 to -0.64, 1.6 high) and four round segments to its right. Their heights rise from the head to segment 3, and the tail is the smallest: segment 1 x -1.24 to 0.36 (1.25 high), segment 2 x -0.14 to 1.56 (1.38), segment 3 x 1.06 to 2.86 (1.48), tail x 2.36 to 3.76 (1). Segment 1 goes 0.6 into the head (-1.24 < -0.64), and each segment presses 0.5 into the next: they join. Front left: two flat white feet lie on the ground and stick out to the left of the head, one at z 0.75 turned 25 degrees to point to the front left, one at z 0.1 pointing left. Top: a long round white tube lies on the head, 3.8 long, turned 30 degrees from x so it runs to the back right. Its front is a flat round side, 1.36 wide, at the front left (center x -3.29, z 0.62). From there it swells slowly and steadily to its fattest part, 1.76 wide, at two thirds of its length (x -1.06, z -0.67), then ends in a big round back. Its outside is 2 egg shapes one after the other (each 2 domes back to back), sized so the outline rises with no dip; the egg tips stay hidden inside. Over the head center its bottom is 0.16 under the head top (1.6), so it sits on the head; its fat back hangs over the back of the head and segment 1. The round door hole on the head, the hole in the front of the tube, and all the small round windows are not shapes: they will be painted in textures.
